$Comment:
The Disenchanter's Grimoire chase, luck-scaled. This file carries the id of a table the RPG Stations jar ships and both of its Disenchant actions already list, so folding this pack REPLACES that table in place at both tables: only this version is live, only one grimoire can land per ritual, and nothing names it from an extension (listing it there would roll it twice).

THE ODDS. Chance.Base 0.5 is the jar's own flat chance, one grimoire per two hundred rituals on average with no luck at all. Every whole point of Enchanting's station yield adds a two-hundredth of a percent, up to the 1.25 percent ceiling: about 0.7 percent with part of the kit on (40 points), about 0.8 with the full kit and the mastery bought (54), about 0.85 with Orrin's Grimoire in hand as well (69), and the ceiling at 150 points, past anything the pack supplies, so a heavily geared or modded luck source cannot turn the chase into a certainty. The grimoire's own Enchanting luck never counts here, since nobody holds it while chasing it; Orrin's Grimoire, held while working, does.

THE GATE stays the jar's: gear of item level 20 and up, so a heap of crude daggers never farms it. That Condition reads the piece, so a quest Claim (no piece in context) cannot roll this table.

The win is an item grant, straight to the worker (dropped at the table when the bag is full), reported as station output, so an achievement or a quest step naming RPG_Weapon_Spellbook_Grimoire_Disenchanter advances on it. Cue:Trophy is the jar action's own gold-and-purple moment and plays only when the book actually landed.

Every number is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.
